q: When should I plant maize in Ejura?
draft:
To determine the planting time for maize in Ejura, consider the following:

- Plant after three good rains within the planting window to ensure enough soil moisture for germination and early growth [IITA-MAIZE-2025:p15-three-good-rains].
- Sow after the rains have stabilized to avoid wilting [MOFA-MAIZE:p10-when-to-plant].

The major season transition period is either from mid-March to end of April [MOFA-MAIZE:p11-transition-major] or from end of March to end of April [IITA-MAIZE-2025:p16-transition-major]. The minor season transition period is either from mid-July through August to early September [MOFA-MAIZE:p12-transition-minor] or from mid-July to early September [IITA-MAIZE-2025:p16-transition-minor]. Choose which source to follow.

A rainfall record is attached for the officer's reference [RAINFALL-OPEN-METEO:ejura:2026-10-25]. The guides give no rainfall amount that marks onset, so the officer decides whether the condition is met.
